description.zh: 光穿过屋檐，落在慢下来的日子里。
description.en: Light through the rafters. A day taking its time.

description.zh: 让风替我们翻一页，留住眼前的自然。
description.en: Let the breeze turn a page. Keep a moment of nature.

description.zh: 水面很安静，风景也有了回声。
description.en: Still water, and an echo of the world around it.

description.zh: 不用赶路，花正在这里盛开。
description.en: No need to hurry. The flowers are already here.

description.zh: 一抹红，接通旧时光。
description.en: A touch of red. A connection to another time.

description.zh: 猫、树影和缓缓流动的日常。
description.en: A cat, some shade, and everyday life in motion.

description.zh: 午后的故事，留给路边的猫。
description.en: An afternoon story, left to the cats along the way.

description.zh: 红色的枝叶，把一面墙变成了风景。
description.en: A red branch turns a quiet wall into a view.

description.zh: 有些风景，抬头才会遇见。
description.en: Some surprises are waiting just above you.

description.zh: 竹叶轻轻摆动，风有了自己的形状。
description.en: Bamboo sways gently. The breeze takes shape.

description.zh: 一片树影，也是一段可以重逢的记忆。
description.en: A patch of shade. A memory to meet again.

description.zh: 远处的山色，近处的心情。
description.en: Distant hills. A feeling close to home.

description.zh: 台灯、木柜，与不必出门的下午。
description.en: A lamp, a wooden cabinet, an afternoon at home.

description.zh: 有些心情，适合在独处时慢慢显影。
description.en: Some feelings develop best in a moment alone.

description.zh: 在一片绿里，发现一点意外的红。
description.en: An unexpected splash of red in a sea of green.

description.zh: 偶然遇见的色彩，像一个小小的惊喜。
description.en: A chance encounter with color. A small surprise.

description.zh: 脚下的线条，是城市写给路人的字。
description.en: Lines underfoot. A little note from the city.

description.zh: 微光与叶影，组成一段短短的诗。
description.en: Soft light and leaves. A little poem in motion.

description.zh: 走走停停，也能看见生活的纹理。
description.en: Pause between steps and see the texture of everyday life.

description.zh: 阳光落在荒草上，时间变得柔软。
description.en: Sunlight on wild grass. Time softens.

description.zh: 认真看看，日常藏着许多可爱。
description.en: Look a little closer. Everyday life is full of little joys.

description.zh: 石阶与草地之间，藏着走过的时间。
description.en: Between the stone steps and the grass, traces of time.

description.zh: 走过长廊，收藏一天将尽的光。
description.en: The last light of the day, held in a quiet corridor.

description.zh: 熟悉的小路，也值得停下来记录。
description.en: A familiar lane, worth pausing to remember.

description.zh: 把午后的时间，留给一只猫。
description.en: An afternoon kept in the company of a cat.

description.zh: 树影与门前的光，安静地留在这里。
description.en: Shade and light linger quietly at the doorway.

description.zh: 缝隙里的一点绿，是生活的小小惊喜。
description.en: A little green in a crack. A small surprise in everyday life.

description.zh: 流水经过石阶，把声音留在记忆里。
description.en: Water over stone steps, a sound held in memory.

description.zh: 换一个角度，看看石缝里的生命。
description.en: Another angle on the life growing between stones.

description.zh: 树旁的光影，像夏天留下的一封信。
description.en: Light beside a tree. A letter left by summer.

description.zh: 舞台上的神情，也能成为一张日常的珍藏。
description.en: An expression on stage, kept as a treasured moment.

description.zh: 日光与影子，把路面写成一幅画。
description.en: Sunlight and shadow draw a picture on the pavement.

description.zh: 一抹鲜红，藏在绿意之间。
description.en: A bright touch of red, tucked among the green.

description.zh: 把流水与此刻的心情一起留下。
description.en: Keep the flowing water and the feeling of this moment.

description.zh: 深深浅浅的绿，让时间慢下来。
description.en: Layers of green let time slow down.

description.zh: 绿意轻轻摇晃，留住夏天的尾声。
description.en: Green leaves sway gently. Keep the last days of summer.

description.zh: 让雨落下的声音与画面一起留住。
description.en: Keep the sound and sight of falling rain.

description.zh: 从一扇小小的窗，看见城市的颜色。
description.en: The colors of the city through a little window.

description.zh: 竹影缓缓摆动，让这一刻多停留一会儿。
description.en: Bamboo sways slowly. Let this moment linger.

description.zh: 花与风一起，把日常变成短短的诗。
description.en: Flowers and wind turn the everyday into a little poem.
